name: Android Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/android.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/android.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: android-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: frontend

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Android APK
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.47.7"
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build release APK
        run: flutter build apk --release

      - name: Build App Bundle
        run: flutter build appbundle --release

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-apk-${{ github.sha }}
          path: frontend/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload App Bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-aab-${{ github.sha }}
          path: frontend/build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

name: iOS Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ios.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/ios.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ios-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    working-directory: frontend

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build iOS (no codesign)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: "3.47.7"
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build iOS (no codesign)
        run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign

      - name: Package Runner.app
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/ios-artifact
          cp -R build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app build/ios-artifact/
          cd build/ios-artifact
          zip -r Runner.app.zip Runner.app

      - name: Upload iOS artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-runner-${{ github.sha }}
          path: frontend/build/ios-artifact/Runner.app.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

content.text:
레포는 이미 **public**이고, 워크플로 두 개를 추가했습니다.

| 파일 | 내용 |
|------|------|
| `.github/workflows/android.yml` | `ubuntu-latest` · analyze/test · release **APK + AAB** 업로드 |
| `.github/workflows/ios.yml` | `macos-latest` · analyze/test · `flutter build ios --no-codesign` · `Runner.app.zip` 업로드 |

- 트리거: `main` push/PR (`frontend/**` 변경 시) + 수동 `workflow_dispatch`
- Flutter **3.47.7** (로컬 stable과 동일)

흔한 구조는 이렇습니다.

1. **병렬 빌드** — `android` / `ios` job을 한 워크플로에서 동시에 실행

set -euo pipefail
KEYSTORE_DIR="/home/yjnoh/Works/my-care/frontend/android"
KEYSTORE_PATH="$KEYSTORE_DIR/upload-keystore.jks"
STORE_PASS=$(openssl rand -base64 24 | tr -d '/+=' | head -c 24)
KEY_PASS="$STORE_PASS"
ALIAS="upload"

# Remove old keystore if any (fresh setup)
rm -f "$KEYSTORE_PATH"

keytool -genkeypair -v \
  -keystore "$KEYSTORE_PATH" \
  -alias "$ALIAS" \
  -keyalg RSA \
  -keysize 2048 \
  -validity 10000 \
  -storepass "$STORE_PASS" \
  -keypass "$KEY_PASS" \
  -dname "CN=My Care, OU=Mobile, O=lelalela, L=Seoul, ST=Seoul, C=KR" \
  -storetype JKS

# Local key.properties (gitignored)
cat > "$KEYSTORE_DIR/key.properties" <<EOF
storePassword=$STORE_PASS
keyPassword=$KEY_PASS
keyAlias=$ALIAS
storeFile=upload-keystore.jks
EOF

# Backup secrets locally outside repo for user recovery
BACKUP_DIR="$HOME/.config/my-care"
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
cp "$KEYSTORE_PATH" "$BACKUP_DIR/upload-keystore.jks"
cat > "$BACKUP_DIR/android-signing.env" <<EOF
ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS=$ALIAS
ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD=$STORE_PASS
ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASS
EOF
chmod 600 "$BACKUP_DIR/android-signing.env" "$BACKUP_DIR/upload-keystore.jks"

# GitHub secrets
BASE64_KS=$(base64 -w 0 "$KEYSTORE_PATH")
gh secret set ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 -R lelalela/my-care --body "$BASE64_KS"
gh secret set ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD -R lelalela/my-care --body "$STORE_PASS"
gh secret set ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD -R lelalela/my-care --body "$KEY_PASS"
gh secret set ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS -R lelalela/my-care --body "$ALIAS"

echo "OK keystore=$(ls -la "$KEYSTORE_PATH" | awk '{print $5}') bytes"
gh secret list -R lelalela/my-care
# never print passwords
echo "BACKUP=$BACKUP_DIR"

input.contents:
name: Mobile Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        description: "릴리즈 태그 (예: v1.0.0). 비우면 run 번호 기반 draft 릴리즈"
        required: false
        type: string

concurrency:
  group: mobile-release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  FLUTTER_VERSION: "3.47.7"

jobs:
  android:
    name: Android (signed)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: ${{ env.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Decode Android keystore
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then
            echo "Android signing secrets are missing."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > android/upload-keystore.jks
          cat > android/key.properties <<EOF
          storePassword=$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
          keyPassword=$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD
          keyAlias=$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS
          storeFile=upload-keystore.jks
          EOF

      - name: Flutter pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build signed release APK
        run: flutter build apk --release

      - name: Build signed App Bundle
        run: flutter build appbundle --release

      - name: Verify APK signature
        run: |
          "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/"*/apksigner verify --verbose \
            build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

      - name: Upload Android artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-release
          path: |
            frontend/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
            frontend/build/app/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  ios:
    name: iOS (no codesign)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          flutter-version: ${{ env.FLUTTER_VERSION }}
          channel: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Flutter pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build iOS (no codesign)
        run: flutter build ios --release --no-codesign

      - name: Package Runner.app
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/ios-artifact
          cp -R build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app build/ios-artifact/
          cd build/ios-artifact
          zip -r Runner.app.zip Runner.app

      - name: Upload iOS artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-release
          path: frontend/build/ios-artifact/Runner.app.zip
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  release:
    name: GitHub Release
    needs: [android, ios]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download Android artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: android-release
          path: dist/android

      - name: Download iOS artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ios-release
          path: dist/ios

      - name: Prepare release files
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist/release
          cp dist/android/app-release.apk dist/release/my-care-android.apk
          cp dist/android/app-release.aab dist/release/my-care-android.aab
          cp dist/ios/Runner.app.zip dist/release/my-care-ios-runner.app.zip
          ls -lah dist/release

      - name: Resolve release tag
        id: meta
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ -n "${{ inputs.tag_name }}" ]; then
            TAG="${{ inputs.tag_name }}"
          elif [[ "${{ github.ref }}" == refs/tags/* ]]; then
            TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          else
            TAG="mobile-${{ github.run_number }}"
            echo "draft=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Resolved tag: $TAG"

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
          name: My Care ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}
          draft: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.draft == 'true' }}
          generate_release_notes: true
          files: |
            dist/release/my-care-android.apk
            dist/release/my-care-android.aab
            dist/release/my-care-ios-runner.app.zip
          body: |
            ## Downloads
            - **Android APK** (`my-care-android.apk`) — 서명된 설치 파일
            - **Android AAB** (`my-care-android.aab`) — Play Store 업로드용
            - **iOS Runner** (`my-care-ios-runner.app.zip`) — 무서명 CI 아티팩트 (실기기/스토어용 아님)

            iOS 스토어/실기기 배포는 Apple 서명·프로비저닝 설정 후 가능합니다.

          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ] || [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then
            echo "Android signing secrets are missing."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 -d > android/upload-keystore.jks
          printf '%s\n' \
            "storePassword=$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" \
            "keyPassword=$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" \
            "keyAlias=$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" \
            "storeFile=upload-keystore.jks" \
            > android/key.properties

      - name: Flutter pub get
        run: flutter pub get

      - name: Analyze
        run: flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos

      - name: Run tests
        run: flutter test

      - name: Build signed release APK
        run: flutter build apk --release

      - name: Build signed App Bundle
        run: flutter build appbundle --release

      - name: Verify APK signature
        run: jarsigner -verify -verbose -certs build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

구성 완료했습니다. 로컬에서 서명 APK 빌드·인증서(`CN=My Care`)까지 확인했습니다.

**변경 요약**
- 통합 워크플로: `.github/workflows/mobile-release.yml` (기존 android/ios 분리 파일 제거)
- Android 릴리즈 서명: `build.gradle.kts` + GitHub Secrets 등록
- 같은 Release에 APK / AAB / iOS zip 첨부

**사용법**
```bash
git tag v1.0.0
git push origin v1.0.0
```
또는 Actions → **Mobile Release** → Run workflow

**보안**
- 키스토어/비밀번호는 레포에 없음 (gitignore)
- Secrets: `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS`, `ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD`
- 백업: `~/.config/my-care/` (키스토어 + env) — Play Store에 올린 뒤에는 이 키를 분실하면 업데이트 불가하니 보관하세요

iOS는 아직 무서명이라 실기기/스토어 설치용이 아닙니다.

커밋·푸시할까요?

action에서 빌드하면 releases까지 반영해줄수있어?

가능하고, **이미 그렇게 되어 있습니다.**

`mobile-release.yml`의 마지막 `release` job이 Android/iOS 빌드가 끝나면 GitHub Releases에 올립니다.

| 트리거 | 결과 |
|--------|------|
| `v1.0.0` 태그 push | 해당 태그로 **Release 생성** + APK/AAB/iOS zip 첨부 |
| Actions에서 수동 실행 + 태그 입력 | 그 태그로 Release 생성 |
| 수동 실행 + 태그 비움 | `mobile-{run번호}` draft Release |

content.text:
커밋·푸시 완료했습니다. (`05da85b`)

**APK vs AAB**

- **APK**: 기기에 바로 설치하는 완성 패키지. 사이드로드·GitHub Releases 배포에 씁니다.
- **AAB (Android App Bundle)**: Play Store 업로드용 중간 포맷. 스토어가 기기별로 필요한 리소스만 잘라 **최적화된 APK**를 만들어 배포합니다. 용량이 줄고, Play에 올릴 때는 사실상 AAB가 필수입니다. **AAB만으로는 폰에 바로 설치는 안 됩니다.**

정리하면, 직접 설치·테스트는 **APK**, Play Store 제출은 **AAB**입니다.
